About Tony's Barber Shop

Tony's Barber Shop is a family-owned barbershop in Dee Why, offering premium hair cutting in all styles — new school, old school, and everything in between. Honest service, consistent cuts, and a chair that's always got time for a chat.

  • Family owned
  • Open from 7am Saturdays
